versions.changelog: Implement step 2 of the one rule. This skill has documented a two-step mandatory gate since 0.1.0 - free preflight AND free merchant_card (wash_flagged -> do not pay) - but example.ts only ever called preflight and then proceeded to the payment path. It never fetched merchant_card at all, so anyone following the example paid counterparties the documentation says to refuse. Caught by the ClawHub scanner on 0.2.0 (TP4, HIGH, 0.93) after 0.2.0 cleared the other five findings. twzrdMerchantCard() is now wired into createClawRouterOnBeforePaymentHook: wash_flagged refuses, and in enforce mode an unreachable card is unresolved and also refuses. in_corpus:false does not refuse, since most wallets are not in the corpus. Verified live: a wash-flagged merchant is refused where 0.2.0 allowed it, and the clean warn control still passes.

Security pass on the ClawHub scanner findings (0.1.2 scored CRITICAL / DO_NOT_INSTALL, 5 issues). BREAKING: preflight now fails closed - an unreachable gate (timeout / non-2xx / network error) returns decision=block instead of allow; pass mode:'advisory' for the old behavior, which logs TWZRD-GATE-BYPASS on every bypass. verifyReceiptIfAny is replaced by verifyReceipt(receipt, note), which verifies the receipt you pass and fails closed on null/malformed/failed/unreachable - the old function ignored its argument, verified our own public sample, and returned true from its catch block. Sample-only checking moved to demoVerifySampleReceipt(). Added a Capabilities and permissions section declaring the network allowlist, the single env var, and the absence of any secret access. Also: the hook's endpoint and failOpen options were dead code and are now wired; importing the module no longer runs the demo (it could process.exit(1) the importing process); the example.ts embedded in SKILL.md is now byte-identical to the sibling file instead of a drifted snapshot.
Demand experiment: upstream onBeforePayment hook for ClawRouter proxy settlements plus live receipt verify step
Install section and ClawRouter preflight flow updates
Initial prototype: preflight gate + TS example for ClawRouter/BlockRun/OpenClaw x402 flows
